Alpha Operations Guide
The alpha platform is operated by a small on call rotation that hands over every week.

Alpha Operations Guide
Operations
Deployment
Rollout Waves
Rollback Drill
Wave one covers the internal staging fleet only.
Wave two adds the two smallest production regions.
Wave three covers every remaining production region.
Each wave is gated by an automatic health probe.
The drill is repeated every quarter by the on call pair.
Findings from the drill are filed as follow up items.

Alpha Operations Guide
Operations
Capacity Notes
ZQXSENTINELALPHA marks the beginning of the capacity note that follows. The capacity planning window for the alpha fleet spans three consecutive quarters and is reviewed by the platform guild every month. Each region keeps a standing reservation of compute that is never handed back to the shared pool during a freeze period. Storage growth is projected from the trailing ninety day average and then padded by a fixed safety factor agreed with finance. When a projection exceeds the reservation the guild files a procurement ticket and records the expected delivery date in the ledger. Network egress is tracked separately because the billing model differs sharply between the internal backbone

and the public transit links. A quarterly review compares the projection against the realised usage and the delta is folded back into the next projection round. Any region that misses its projection twice in a row is placed under a stricter weekly review until the drift disappears. The guild publishes the resulting numbers in a read only ledger so that every downstream team can plan against the same figures. Omega Appendix
Retention
Operational logs are retained for ninety days and then archived to cold storage.

Omega Appendix
Contacts
The appendix is maintained by the reliability team and reviewed twice a year.

Beta Quarterly Report
Regional Revenue
The table below lists the revenue recorded per region for the first two quarters.
Region | Q1 | Q2 | Total
Zurich | 8200 | 10220 | 18420
Dublin | 7400 | 9110 | 16510
Osaka | 6100 | 7350 | 13450

Beta Quarterly Report
Outlook
Revenue is expected to grow moderately in the third quarter across all three regions.

Summary
A partial outage affected the delta ingestion tier for eleven minutes. Requests were shed by the load balancer while the tier was restarted. No data loss was observed and the backlog drained within the hour.

Follow Up
The restart procedure is now covered by an automated health probe. A capacity review is scheduled before the next seasonal peak.

Gamma Steering Minutes
The steering group met to review the migration programme.

Gamma Steering Minutes
Decisions
The migration of the reporting service is approved for the next window.
The legacy exporter is frozen and only security fixes are accepted.
